item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your calendar shows a clear wind-down: a relaxation exercise, then a fixed bedtime. That's the right structure. The weak spot is the stretch before it, when evening tasks and check-ins can keep your mind working. Treat that block as a closing routine, not more problem-solving. Put worries on paper, then leave them there. Tonight's action: set a phone alarm for twenty minutes before bedtime, and when it rings, stop all planning.
